text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Wednesday it will buy Noris Verbraucherbank GmbH from the Schickedanz group in a move that will bring it 280,000 additional customers and lead to synergy benefits worth 130 million marks.

Vereinsbank said it will merge Noris with its own subsidiary WKV Bank GmbH, creating a retail banking subsidiary with a network of more than 100 branches across Germany, 370,000 customers, a lending volume of 3.6 billion marks and deposits totalling 4.5 billion marks.
Vereinsbank did not disclose the purchase price. It will hold a news conference in Munich at 1000 GMT.

"With the purchase of Noris Verbraucherbank, Vereinsbank...is obtaining a well established brand in consumer banking and a branch network which ideally complements Franken WKV," Vereinsbank said in a statement.

Merging the two banks would lead to synergy benefits with a cash value of 130 million marks, the bank said. The synergies will result from the harmonisation of product ranges and the transfer of data processing systems from WKV to Noris, Vereinsbank said.
The merged bank will become a specialist for consumer credit within the Vereinsbank group.
By selling Noris, Schickedanz has withdrawn from branch-based banking and will concentrate on telephone banking through its subsidiary Quelle-Bank, Vereinsbank said.
Wednesday's announcement did not come as a complete surprise. Noris said last week it was seeking a partner and there had been speculation that Vereinsbank may be a possible candidate.
